ai.greeting: Welcome to CASPEL AI. Ask me any question regarding our enterprise software products and presentations.
questions: What is CASPEL ERP and what modules does it include?
How does CASPEL PMS automate procurement bidding?
What are the compliance capabilities of IRISSEA LRIT?

ai.rateLimited: That is a lot of questions in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
ai.networkError: The connection dropped before an answer came back. Please try again.

ai.streamInterrupted: The answer was interrupted. Please ask again.
